name: Step Sis Is Kinda Horny?!
source:
Your new family isn't what you expected... it's way hotter! 
After years of living alone and wasting your life away, your dad calls you with a surprise: he got remarried, and now you're living with your three brand-new stepsisters!
The catch? They're cute... and way too dangerous for your sanity. 
Explore your messy apartment, get to know each girl, and make choices that could lead to love... or something much steamier.
 Can you resist the temptation, or will you give in?  Comedy, romance, and spicy situations await you in Step Sis Is Kinda Horny?!
